exceptions.reason: The new core answers upstream errors with an error body it builds itself (message, type and code), not the upstream's JSON passed through; recorded as a deliberate difference when the core skeleton was built.
When every account is cooling after an upstream failure, today's core answers 503 auth_unavailable; the new core answers 429 model_cooldown, as for any cooldown, with the same Retry-After.
Follows from the status: the new core's model_cooldown error in place of today's auth_unavailable.
